newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti shares resume trade up 11.43 pct.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti shares resume trade up 11.43 pct.

text.p: Shares in Italian information and technology group Olivetti resumed trading up 11.43 percent at 809 lire after dealers said the Milan bourse trade ceiling had been raised to 15 percent.

At 0905 GMT, Olivetti shares were up 11.29 percent at 808 lire after a day's high of 820 lire following the resignation late on Tuesday of group chairman Carlo De Benedetti and the publication of the company's first half 1996 results.

Olivetti shares were earlier suspended up 10 percent just after the bourse opened and remained suspended for around 45 minutes. Dealers said that the bourse had raised the ceiling to 15 percent from 10 percent, but there was no confirmation from the bourse authorities.
The group reported late Tuesday that it had made a pretax loss of 440.2 billion lire in the first half of 1996, with declining sales and a rise in net debt.
